notes: Updates page: Update client replaces only the original RapTech.exe on the game disk; computers are never updated directly and start the new version at their next restart ("at next restart" on their row). A warning shows, and Update client says why, when the original RapTech.exe is not set or not found. A replaced file's old copy is kept a week, so a computer still running it is not disturbed. Goes with client 1.80.4.
